reviews.title: Great headset, completely worth the investment!
reviews.comment: Worth the investment if you work from home but also have little ones running around in the background! I am amazed at how much background noise suppression these headsets provide. It is lightweight, but not to the point where the quality would be compromised. It is easy to connect to my phone and laptop for work!
reviews.author: Jenny Sanders

reviews.title: Good Headset
reviews.comment: So far I like it. From my experience the noise canceling microphone has been okayish there are times people can hear her and other times is slightly muted. Battery life is great and the connectivity with the dongle is quick and effortless. Head set is easy to use and straight forward. Microphone is clear to the people on the other end.
reviews.author: Samantha

reviews.title: Not worth the price.
reviews.comment: Great headphones but at times does not sound proof like it says. When working sometimes they can hear the background noise and other times can't. Unsure what is wrong with them on that aspect. For the price I wouldn't recommend due to the weird back and forth jump on audio. :(
reviews.author: Lily__24

reviews.title: Poor software makes for ear pain - seems to have been sent the non ANC version
reviews.comment:
Good sound, poor software for interface with PC and Mobile.   Too bad HP ruined Plantronics & PLT, so I was hoping this would be a viable option.  Software with PC is poor, resulting in FULL VOLUME when it auto switches between sources.  really hurts my ears.
I realize several months later that my unit is in fact the EPOS Impact 1060T without ANC even though I had ordered the EPOS Impact 1061T which is listed as having ANC.  Now that I need it (new furnace makes a droning sound)... I'm pissed.
reviews.author: E. S.

reviews.title: Truly Noise Camcellation- Worth the Invest.
reviews.comment: This product is a super game changer working from home and having kids. I am able to play my tv and have my baby boy in the back ground cooing without my mic picking up. This product really does what it say- mutes every background noise surrounding you.
reviews.author: Ladii
